title: A finite coloring is a Roelcke coloring exactly when it depends only on the pattern with one finite substructure
author: Lionel Nguyen Van Thé
work: Fixed points in compactifications and combinatorial counterparts
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 2 (2019), pp. 149-185, publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.16
difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 doi:10.5802/ahl.16 的 Proposition prop:Roelcke coloring（源 515-517 行，与相邻的 prop:RoelckeRP 共用证明块 523-525 行）：设 F 是 Fraïssé 结构、A∈Age(F)、χ 是有限着色，则 χ∈ROB(Aut(F)) 当且仅当存在有限子结构 Z 使 χ(a) 只依赖 [a,z]（z 取恒等嵌入）。证明要点不是例行核验：正方向要把「Roelcke 一致连续」翻成「只依赖模式」（用 F 的 Roelcke 一致同构与模式的关系，取出使取值穷尽的有限 Z）；反方向要把「只依赖 [a,z]」翻回一致连续（着色经**模式映射**分解，而模式映射对该一致结构连续）。难点在把一致结构语言与模式语言来回翻译，且 Z 的取法要显式给出。原文位置在证明的 524 行；同一块末句起就是相邻命题（量化形式）的证明，本卡不取那部分。

primary.label: author Proposition environment, source label prop:Roelcke coloring (statement, source lines 515-517)

proof_spans.label: the author's proof environment that carries this statement together with the next one (source lines 523-525): the forward direction recognises the coloring of patterns as a Roelcke coloring, and the converse lifts a finite set of Roelcke colorings to one coloring of the patterns of a larger substructure
